quote.translation: As Becker also points out (l. c. S. 539), actuality is the "direct mode" (modus rectus), whereas possibility, which takes its steps towards the actual, and necessity, which advances its steps from the actual, are both the "oblique mode" (modus obli- quus).

quote.translation: Brentano, in his theory of time, made the present the "direct mode" and the future and the past the "oblique mode" (F. Brentano, Psychologie vom empirischen Standpunkt, hrsg. v. Kraus, II, S. 225).

regions.text: 現實としての現在性は「正頑」さるべきものであるに反して、可能性の有つ未来性と必然性の有つ過去性とは、現在の現實性に立つ者が右と左へ「斜視することによってはじめて観閣に入れることの出来るものである。

quote.translation: Presentness, as the actual, is to be "looked at straight on", whereas the futurity of possibility and the pastness of necessity can be brought into the field of vision only when one who stands in the actuality of the present "looks obliquely" to the right and to the left.

regions.text: 視することによってはじめて観閣に入れること

quote.translation: The temporal priority of contingency follows from this.

regions.text: 偶然性の時間性的優位もそこから蹄結する。事態を有鐙に原に直観するならば、必然性の否定として偶然性が體驗されるのでもなく可能性に開職して偶然性が會得されるのでもない。

quote.translation: If we intuit states of affairs bodily and originarily, contingency is neither experienced as the negation of necessity nor understood in connection with possibility.

regions.text: 現在において現實としての偶然を正視することが根源前一次的の原始約事實である。次で二次的に未来への動向として未水約な可能を斜視し過去よりの存額として過去な必然を斜視する場合が考へられるのである。

quote.translation: To look straight at the contingent as the actual in the present is the original, primary and primal fact, and then, secondarily, we can think of looking obliquely at the futural possible as a tendency towards the future, and at the past necessary as continuance from the past.

regions.text: 換育すれば可能性および必然性は自己の時間性格そのものによつて單に斜視によ3目撃され得ないものである。

quote.translation: In other words, possibility and necessity, by their very temporal character, can be witnessed only obliquely, and the only modality that can be looked at straight on is contingency, present at a single point.

regions.text: 正観され得る様相は一點に於て現在する個然だけしかない。偶然性が必然性の否定として、または可能性の相開者として規定されるのは體験の直接性を既に離脱した論理の簡域に於てである。

quote.translation: That contingency is determined as the negation of necessity, or as the correlate of possibility, belongs to the domain of logic, which has already departed from the immediacy of experience.
In the immediacy of experience, the contingent, as the mode of looking straight on, as the direct mode, holds temporal priority insofar as it has its position in the present.
